name: bareeq
description: Bareeq Al-Aeeq - prestige interior atelier. Angular web experience + Expo mobile app sharing one design-token source of truth.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix portal install && npm --prefix mobile install
scripts.icons: npm --prefix web run icons && npm --prefix portal run icons
scripts.icons:check: npm --prefix web run icons:check && npm --prefix portal run icons:check
scripts.check: npm run tokens:check && npm run icons:check && npm run web:lint && npm run web:typecheck && npm run web:test && npm run portal:lint && npm run portal:typecheck && npm run portal:test && npm run mobile:typecheck && npm run mobile:lint
scripts.reset: npm run clean:deps && npm run install:all && npm run tokens
